However, the role of Notch signals during αβ versus γδ T lineage decision remains controversial. Here, we addressed this question by employing a clonal analysis of CD4 − CD8 − (DN) progenitor potential to position the divergence of αβ and γδ T cell lineages to the late DN2 to DN3 developmental stages. Accordingly, αβ and γδ precursor frequencies within these T cell progenitor subsets were determined, both in the presence and absence of Notch signaling through Delta-like 1.
